system.description:
Where most Daughters of Cacophony can touch only a single listener with hidden speech or madness, the Virtuosa's performance carries her music to a whole audience at once, spreading her gift — or her curse — across a crowd.

Expend one Blood Trait to extend either Phantom Speaker or Siren's Beckoning to as many as five targets at once (retest Performance). With Phantom Speaker, every subject hears the same words or music you project; with Siren's Beckoning, you make a single mass Social Challenge against all the victims together. You can use only one power at a time — you cannot project speech to some listeners while singing madness into others simultaneously.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
